hypotheses.H1: Compiled H-divides-L_V constraints exactly encode the existing restricted RR coefficient search.
hypotheses.H2: Removing explicit roots improves first-verified-relation completion on matched subspace instances.
hypotheses.H3: Incrementally conditioning two bits of b improves the root-free solver within the same total per-instance budget.
hypotheses.H4: A practical advantage survives increasing field sizes; a full cost/scaling claim additionally needs the strongest Semaev baseline and operation accounting.

domain: y^2+xy=x^3+1; three summands; nonzero distinct x in span(first d ONB vectors); x different from target x; finite targets; RR b nonzero
target_policy: Seeded uniform affine targets and separately labeled seeded samples from the exhaustive oracle's supported targets; strata may overlap and are not pooled as a natural hit probability.
conditioned_policy: Enumerate b low-two-bit assignments 0,1,2,3 with assumptions on one incremental solver; one shared total deadline; first verified relation stops the search.
comparison: Same base, exact target, and arity per paired row. SAT requires direct point verification; UNSAT must agree with exhaustive group arithmetic. Timeout is incomplete, not UNSAT.
validation: Exhaust all 992 coefficient pairs a,b!=0 at n5,d3 on one fixed target: full IR remainder vector equals independent scalar polynomial remainder. Check CNF decision correctness on the frozen target panel; audit every emitted model and recovered certificate.
falsification: Any circuit/scalar or model/curve mismatch invalidates H1 implementation. No better matched completion falsifies H2 or H3 only on the tested panel. H4 remains unestablished without calibrated operation cost and symmetrized S4 baseline.
metrics: Verified SAT/UNSAT decisions, incomplete cases, source-CNF sizes, construction/loading/solve/verification diagnostic times, first-verified relation, rejected candidates, branch count. Full attack S and rho ratio null.
counting_boundary: At fixed base and arity exact target support is invariant. No encoding change increases genuine relation yield.
performance_target: 20% lower all-phase verified-relation cost at three increasing sizes against the strongest matched Semaev baseline; not dischargeable by this diagnostic-only panel.
source_policy: No changes to old contracts or results. Append raw rows immediately; keep all failed and timed-out cases. Scientific verdicts scope to the actual experiment.
